clusters.headline: Himachal hemp and cannabis licence fees revised weeks ago, no fresh peg
clusters.summary: Himachal Pradesh's Department of Taxes and Excise notified industrial hemp licensing in late July 2026 with a Rs 2,000 per bigha annual cultivator fee.
